summary: Frontend-only testing (no backend) of 4 new features on preview URL: (1) GM Kodları category tabs + per-row copy, (2) Home '📚 Son Rehberler & Blog' strip, (3) Blog list -> /blog/:id detail, (4) Blog detail share bar + back + invalid-id guard. All 4 features work. Found and fixed one real defect: unhandled Promise rejection from navigator.clipboard.writeText (GmKodlari + BlogDetail) which raised an uncaught runtime error and, in the dev environment, rendered a full-screen webpack overlay iframe that intercepted ALL pointer events (page became unusable after clicking any copy button). Added .catch() guards; re-tested and UI stays fully interactive.

ui_bugs.issue: navigator.clipboard.writeText() promise was not caught -> 'NotAllowedError: Write permission denied' uncaught runtime error; dev overlay iframe (#webpack-dev-server-client-overlay) then blocked every subsequent click. FIXED by testing agent with .catch(() => {}).

issues: 'Tümü →' link sits outside the home-blog-strip container and previously had no data-testid; added data-testid='home-blog-all' for testability (no visual change)

action_items: Review the two .catch() guards added by the testing agent (GmKodlari.jsx, BlogDetail.jsx) — optionally show an error toast when clipboard is unavailable instead of a false success toast.
Optional: use document.execCommand fallback or show 'Kopyalanamadı' when clipboard API is blocked (currently success toast shows even if copy failed).
critical_code_review_comments: Any navigator.clipboard.writeText call must be awaited/caught — an uncaught rejection in CRA dev blocks the whole UI with the error overlay.
Copy handlers show a success toast unconditionally; consider tying the toast to the promise result.
seed_data_creation: None (mock data only; sessionStorage tm2_popup_seen=1 used to bypass popup ad)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified: GM tabs (Tümü=14 rows; Genel 1, Eşya 2, Canavar 3, Quest 2, Yetki 3, Hareket 2, Event 1) filter exclusively and combine with gm-search ('Yetki'+'ban' -> 1 row); gm-copy shows 'Komut panoya kopyalandı!'. Home strip renders exactly 3 posts (home-blog-1/2/3), item click -> /blog/1, 'Tümü →' (now data-testid home-blog-all) -> /blog. /blog has 3 cards; blog-card-2 -> /blog/2 with blog-detail-2, body 172 chars, cover naturalWidth 800, meta 'mert · 2026-05-28'. Share: WhatsApp -> api.whatsapp.com, Twitter -> x.com/intent/tweet (wa.me & twitter.com redirect, so assert on 'whatsapp'/'x.com' too), Facebook -> facebook.com/sharer. share-copy toast 'Bağlantı kopyalandı!'; blog-back-btn -> /blog; /blog/999 -> 'Yazı bulunamadı'. NOTE for selectors: '[data-testid^="home-blog-"]' also matches the strip container — use .blog-strip__item.
rca_of_the_issue: navigator.clipboard.writeText returns a Promise that rejects with NotAllowedError in headless/insecure-permission contexts. Neither copy handler attached a .catch, so the rejection surfaced as an uncaught runtime error; CRA's dev-server error overlay iframe then covered the viewport and swallowed all pointer events, making the page appear frozen. Mitigation: added .catch(() => {}) around both writeText calls.
